questions.question_text: It is given that a scalene triangle has perimeter =  20 and all the sides are integer. What is the probability that 5 is one of the sides of the triangle?
questions.solution_text:
Let $a<b<c$ be the 3 sides of the scalene triangle.
Using triangle inequality we can say that
$a+b > c$. Adding c both sides
$a+b+c > 2c$ .Putting a+b+c = 20
$ 2c < 20$ Thus $c < 10$. Since $c$ is an integer, maximum value of c can be 9
Case I : When c = 9. Then a+b = 11. Since a<b<c=9 the possible pair of (a,b) can be (3,8),(4,7) and (5,6) which satisfy the criteria
Case II: When c= 8, then a+b = 12. Since a<b<c=8 the possible pair of (a,b) can be (5,7) which satisfy all the criteria
Case III: When c= 7, then a+b=13.  Since a<b<c=7. There is no possible pair(a,b) such that a<b<c=7 and a+b+c = 20.
Thus overall 4 cases are possible out of which 2 triangle are there which have one of the side as 5.
Probability = $\frac {2}{4}$ = $\frac{1}{2}$
Alternate Solution:
Total number of scalene triangles = $\frac{\left(n-6\right)^2}{48}$ = $\frac{14^2}{48}=4.0xx\ =\ 4$
Number of scalene triangles with one side as 5:
If one side = 5, the other 2 sides add up to 15. Possible cases are (6,9),(7,8).
Hence, probability = 1/2

questions.question_text: A certain sum of money invested at a certain rate of simple interest triples itself in 30 years. In how many years does this sum become six times?
questions.solution_text:
Let the amount of money be P.
Since it triples itself, the simple interest = 3P - P = 2P.
Now, 2P = P(30)r
r = 2/30
If sum becomes 6 times, them simple interest = 6P - P = 5P
Now, 5P = P(t)(2/30)
t = 75 years.

questions.question_text: A big spherical raindrop of radius 6 mm breaks to form 8 identical smaller spherical raindrops. Find the radius of the smaller raindrop.
questions.solution_text:
Vol. of the big raindrop = $\ \frac{\ 4}{3}\pi\ \times\ 6^3$ = V (say)
Vol. of the small raindrop = $\ \frac{\ 4}{3}\pi\ \\times\ r^3$ = v (say)
Due to conservation of mass, $V=8\times\ v$
=> $\ \frac{\ 4}{3}\pi\ \times\ 6^3$ = 8 x $\ \frac{\ 4}{3}\pi\ \times\ r^3$
=> $\ \frac{\ 6^3}{r^3}=8$
=> r = 3 mm

questions.question_text: Anand and Mahesh are travelling from place A to place B which are 100 km apart. Anand stops for 10 minutes after each km and Mahesh stops for 25 minutes after each 4 km. The ratio of speed of Anand and Mahesh is 11:2. From A, Anand started 1 hour later than Mahesh and both reach B at the same time. Find the time taken(in minutes) by Anand to travel from A to B.
questions.solution_text:
Consider the velocity of Anand 11v and the velocity of Mahesh be 2v.
Then time taken used in traveling(without break) by Anand = 100/(11v)
Total breaks taken by Anand = 99 Time spent in breaks = 99*10 =990
Total time taken by Anand = 100/(11v)+ 990
Time taken used in traveling (without break) by Mahesh = 100/(2v)
Total breaks taken by Mahesh = 24 Time spent in breaks = 25*24 = 600
Total time taken by Mahesh =100/(2v)+600
Since both reach at same time, 100/(11v)+ 990 + 60 = 100/(2v)+600       (Anand started 60 minutes late)
=>100/(2v)- 100/(11v)=450
=> 100/v = 50*22 = 1100
Time taken by Anand = 100/(11v)+ 990 = 100+990 = 1090 minutes

questions.solution_text:
$xyzw = 39039$.
Let’s factorize 39039
$xyzw = 3 * 7 * 11 * 13^2$
Now,
3, 7 and 11 can go to either x, y, z or w. 
169 can go to either of x, y, z or w, or 13 * 13 can go to two of x, y, z or w.
Case 1. When 3,7,11,169 can go to either of x,y,z and w. 
Each of the number have 4 places among (x,y,z,w)
Total number of cases 4*4*4*4.
Case 2. When 13, 13 can go to any two of x,y,z,w; and 3,7,11 have 4 places (x,y,z,w)
Number of ways will be 4C2 *4*4*4
Thus, the number of ordered pairs will be
$ 4 * 4 * 4 * (4 + ^4C_2) = 64 * (10) = 640$

questions.question_text: Consider a circle C1 of radius 2 units rolling externally on the circle C2: $x^2+4y+y^2=0$. The locus of the centre of the circle C1 is another circle C3. What is the area of the quadrilateral formed by a pair of tangents from a point on C3 to the circle C2 with a pair of radii at the points of contact of the tangents?
questions.solution_text:
Given, circle C2= $x^2+4y+y^2=0$
C2= $x^2+\left(y+2\right)^2=2^2$. So, C2 has the centre at (0,-2) and the radius = 2 units.
C1 can be represented as:
Let the centre of C1 be (h,k).
Since C1 touches C2 externally and has a radius of length 2 units, the distance between the centres of the two circles = sum of radii= 2+2=4 units.
Using distance formula,
$\sqrt{\left(h-0\right)^2+\left(k+2\right)^2\ }=4$
Squaring both sides, we get:
$\left(h-0\right)^2+\left(k+2\right)^2\ =16$
So, C3 is a circle with radius 4 units and centre same as C1, (0,-2)
The quadrilateral formed will be something like:
We need to find the area of quadrilateral ABOC.
The required area is twice of area of the triangle AOC, where OC (radius of C2)= 2units, AO (radius of C3)= 4 units
we know that since AC is tangent to C2, $\angle\ ACB=$ $90^{\circ\ }$
So, applying pythagorus theorem, 
$AC^2+OC^2=AO^2$
=>$AC^2=\ 16-4$
=>$AC=\sqrt{12}$
Therefore, area of triangle AOC= $\ \frac{\ 1}{2}\times AC\times OC=\ \frac{\ 1}{2}\times\sqrt{12}\times2=\sqrt{12}\ \ \ $
Therefore area of quadrilateral= $\ 2\sqrt{12}=4\sqrt{3}\ \ \ $

questions.question_text: Ram writes down all positive integers consecutively, starting from 1. He skips every multiple of 10 in the process. What is 3000th digit written by him?
questions.solution_text:
Ram skips every 10th number hence he will skip 10,20,...
So one digit numbers written by Ram = 9 {From 1 to 9}
Two digit numbers written by Ram = 9*9 = 81 {From 11 to 99}
Three digit numbers written by Ram = 9*10*9 = 810 {From 101 to 999}
Exhausting all 3 digit number we will start with four digit number starting from 1001
Four digit numbers from 1001 to 1099 = 9*10 = 90
Four digit numbers from 1101 to 1109 = 9
Total number of digits so far = (1*9) + (2*81) + (3*810) + (4*99) = 2997
3rd digit of next number will be the 3000th digit.
Next number written = 1111
Hence we can say that digit 1 is 3000th digit that is written by Ram.Option D is the correct answer.

questions.question_text: A group of men and women decide to finish a task in 20 days. 10 men can also finish the same task in 20 days. 6 men start working and on the 7th day, 2 women join. On the 8th day, 2 more women join and so on. After working for 15 days from the beginning, it is found that only 60% of the work is completed. On the 16th day, x more women join and worked till the end. If the task was finished on time, what is the value of x?
questions.solution_text:
Assuming each man works 1unit/day, total amount of work = 20*10 = 200 units.
Assuming each woman works y units/ day.
The work finished after 15 days will be =  Work done by men + work done by women = 15*6+2y+4y+.........18y = 90+90y = 200*0.6 = 120 units
=> y =$\ \dfrac{\ 1}{3}$ unit
Work was completed in 20 days. Hence, the rest of the work  = 200-120 = 80 units is completed in 5 days.
Hence, 80 = ( Work done by 6 men + work done by 18 women + work done by x women )  for 5 days
80 = 6*5+18*$\ \dfrac{\ 1}{3}$*5+$\ \dfrac{\ 1}{3}\times\ \left(x\right)$*5
=> 20 = $\dfrac{1}{3}\times\ \left(x\right)$*5
=> x = 12

questions.question_text: Rinesh and Dinesh visit a cafe daily between 8 PM and 9 PM. Everyone spends exactly 10 minutes inside, and those entering after 8:50 PM leave at 9 PM as the cafe closes then. What is the probability that they meet in the cafe?
questions.solution_text:
Both Rinesh and Dinesh can come in a timespan of 60 minutes. 
Let us represent the time(in minutes) when Rinesh comes on x-axis and Dinesh on the y-axis.
Both of them will wait at the stop for 10 minutes.
Since both of them have to meet, the difference between their arrival time has to be less than or equal to 10 minutes.
The area between the blue and the orange coloured lines is the required region. (|x-y|$\le\ 10$)
= 60*60 - 2* $\frac{1}{2}$*50*50 = 1100
Probability that both of them would meet = $\frac{1100}{3600}$
= $\frac{11}{36}$
C is the correct answer.

questions.question_text: A ship is travelling between two port cities with a speed such that it will reach its destination on time. After covering 25% of the distance, the ship faces an emergency and returns to its starting point with a different speed v. It then resumes travelling towards its destination without any further delay with the same speed v. By what percentage is v more than the original speed, if the ship reaches its destination in time?
questions.solution_text:
Assuming the time taken to reach on schedule is t, the distance is d and the initial speed is s.
Then t = $\ \frac{\ d}{s}\ $
Now, time taken to travel 0.25d = $\ \frac{\ 0.25d}{s}$ = 0.25t
Now, distance covered after turning = 0.25d+d = 1.25d
So, the time taken = $\ \frac{\ 1.25d}{v}$
Time left  = t-0.25t = 0.75t
So to cover 1.25d distance, the speed has to be increased to v.
Hence, 0.75t = $\ \frac{\ 0.75d}{s}\ =\ \ \frac{\ 1.25d}{v}$
=> $\ \frac{\ v}{s}=\ \frac{\ 5}{3}$
Hence, the percentage increase  = $\left(\ \frac{\ 5}{3}-1\right)\times\ 100$ = 66.67%

questions.question_text: P can finish a given work in 15 days, Q can finish the same work in 20 days and R can finish the work in 25 days. When they start the work, P comes daily but Q and R come only on alternate days ie Q comes on day 1, R on day 2, Q on day 3 and so on. This cycle continues for 8 days. After that, P finishes the work alone. For every day that a worker shows up, he/she gets ₹500 as labour fee, even if he/she does not work for the whole day. If the total money to be paid for the work is ₹10,000 (excluding the labour fee), find the amount of money earned by P.
questions.solution_text:
Let the total work be $300x$ (300 is LCM of 15,20,25) 
Work done by P in one day $p = \dfrac{300x}{15} = 20x $
Work done by Q in one day $q = \dfrac{300x}{20} = 15x $
Work done by P in one day $r = \dfrac{300x}{25} = 12x $
Amount of work done on odd numbered days = 20x+15x = 35x 
Amount of work done on even numbered days = 20x+12x = 32x 
Total amount of work done in 8 days = 4 x (35x+32x) = 268x 
Amount of work finished alone by P = 300x - 268x = 32x 
Number of days taken by P to finish job = $\dfrac{32x}{20x} $ = 1.6
Total amount of work done by P = 32x + 160x = 192x 
Amount earned from the cost of the job by P = $\dfrac{192x}{300x} \times 10000 $ = ₹6400 
Amount earned as labour fee = 500 x (8+2) = ₹5000
Total money earned by P = 6400+5000 = ₹11,400

We know that Ajay sells cereals in multiple of 1 kg so he will end up getting maximum profit when the discount is minimum.
Discount offered = (x+4)%

questions.question_text: What is the range of the function $f(x) = \dfrac{x^2+x+3}{x^2+x+4}$ if the domain is the set of all real numbers?
questions.solution_text:
$f(x) = \dfrac{x^2+x+3}{x^2+x+4}$ 
= $\dfrac{x^2+x+4}{x^2+x+4} - \dfrac{1}{x^2+x+4}$ 
= $1 - \dfrac{1}{(x+\frac{1}{2})^2+15/4}$
Now the maximum value of the term $\dfrac{1}{(x+\frac{1}{2})^2+15/4}$ will happen when the denominator is least, i.e when x = -1/2. f(x) is minimum when the -ve term is maximum. Hence minimum value of f(x) = f(-1/2) = 11/15
The minimum value of the term $\dfrac{1}{(x+\frac{1}{2})^2+15/4}$ will happen as x tends to $\pm\infty$ and is equal to 0. Hence the maximum value of f(x) tends to 1. Hence the range of f(x) is $[\frac{11}{15},1)$

questions.question_text: In a laboratory, a fission reaction is carried out with a target atom such that its nucleus splits into 3 nuclei. These 3 nuclei further produce 3 nuclei each. The process of splitting takes exactly 2 microseconds. But, at every 4th microsecond one third of the nuclei produced at that instant disintegrate due to gamma exposure. Find out the total number of nuclei present at 100th microsecond.
questions.solution_text:
The process of fission takes place as follows:
So, the power of 2 increases by 1 after every 4 seconds  starting from t= 4 and the power of 3 increases by 1 after every 4 seconds starting from t= 2.
So, we have the below APs of time at which power increases by 1
For Power of 2 = 4, 8, 12, 16...
So, at 100 microseconds
 $4 + (n-1)\times 4=100$
=>$n=25$
Power of 2 will be 25 after 100 microseconds.
Similarly, for power of 3 = 2, 6, 10...
So, at 100 microseconds
$2+(n-1)\times 4= 100$
=> $n=25.5$ which means power of 3 would have reached 25.
So, the total number of nuclei are $2^{25}\times3^{25}$.
Hence, option C is the correct choice.
Alternate explanation:
Every 2 microseconds, the number of nuclei will be multiplied by 3. Every 4 microseconds, the number of nuclei will multiplied by (2/3) due to disintegration. Hence after 100 microseconds, the number of nuclei= $(3)^{\frac{100}{2}} \times (\frac{2}{3})^{\frac{100}{4}}$ = $2^{25} \times 3^{25}$

questions.question_text: An alloy is made of three metals copper, iron and zinc with price per kg Rs 32, Rs 17 and Rs 36 are mixed in ratio x:y:z such that x, y, z are in a geometric progression. If x<y<z and the price of alloy is Rs 30 per kg, then what would be the price per kg of the alloy if they are mixed in ratio x: z :y ?
questions.solution_text:
Consider the common ratio r, then y=xr, z=xr$^{2}$
Now the alloy price = 30 = $\frac{32x+17xr+36r^{2}}{x+xr+xr^{2}}$ 
=> 6r$^{2}$-13r+2 = 0
=> (6r-1)(r-2)=0
=> r=2 (r=1/6 is rejected since x<y<z)
y=2x, z=4x
Hence, new price = (32*x+17*4x+36*2x)/(7x) = 172/7=24.57

questions.question_text: The distance travelled by a ball falling vertically from a tower is directly proportional to the square of the time it has travelled. If it travels 40 m in the first 6 seconds, what will be the distance travelled in the next 30 secs?

After next 30sec, total time travelled =30+6=36sec.

$\frac{X}{40}$= ($(\frac{36}{6})^2$
X=1440
Distance travelled in 30 secs= 1440-40 =1400

questions.question_text: Ram buys apples, oranges, bananas and guavas using Rs 400. The ratio of the number of apples and oranges is 2:3. The ratio of number of bananas and guavas is 4:1. questions.solution_text:
Assuming the number of apples, oranges, bananas and guavas is 2x,3x, 4y and y respectively.
Assume the prices of 1 apple, 1 orange, 1 banana and 1 guava be a, 2a, 3a and 4a respectively.
Now, 2x*a+3x*2a+4y*3a+y*4a = 400
8ax+16ay = 400
=> ax+2ay = 50
Now, the price of apples and guavas = 2x*a+y*4a = 2(ax+2ay)=100

For real numbers x, y and z, xyz-3 =0, x=3-(1/y), z=36-1/x. If y+1/z =a/b where a, b are co-primes. Find the value of b-a.

**Options:**
- **A**. 227
- **B**. 213
- **C**. 194 ✅
- **D**. 207

**Solution:**
We have,  xyz-3 =0,  => 1/y = xz/3
 x=3-(1/y) => x=3-xz/3  => 3x=9-xz   =>xz=9-3x......(1)
 z=36-1/x => xz=36x-1 ......(2)
Equating the value of xz in 1 and 2, we get, 36x-1=9-3x
=> 39x=10   
Now, x=3-1/y => 1/y = 3-x = 3-10/39   
=> 1/y = 107/39
Also, z=36-1/x = 36-39/10 = 321/10
Therefore, y+1/z = 39/107+10/321 = (117+10)/321 = 127/321 = a/b (given)
Hence, b-a = 321-127 = 194

questions.question_text: Ram sells mango in a local area. The goons of the local area charge 20% of the revenue to allow him to sell the mango at that place. By approximately what percent should Ram markup the cost of the mangoes to ensure that after giving a discount of 10% he receives an overall profit of 15%. It is also known that 5% of the mango gets bad and cannot be sold.
questions.solution_text:
Let Ram buy 100 kg of mango at cost price = Rs $CP$/kg. Let the Marked price of the Mango be $MP$.
Since 5% of mango went bad, he only sold 95 kg of mangoes at a discount of 10%.
The revenue Ram will have = $95\times(0.9)MP$
20% of revenue will be taken by the goons, thus 80% will be left with Ram
Total earning of Ram = $95\times\ 0.9\ \times\ 0.8MP$
If he expected 15% profit from the overall transaction, the money he should have got = $100\times\ 1.15CP$ = 115CP
Thus 68.4MP = 115CP
MP = 1.6812 CP
Thus the markup per cent is approximately 68.12%

questions.question_text: A quadratic equation has px$^2$+qx-33=0 has 3 as one of its roots, where p and q are positive integers. If one of the roots of qx$^2$+px-24 = 0 is an integer, then the value of p+2q is
questions.solution_text:
We have, px$^2$+qx-33=0
Since 3 is one of the roots, hence, 9p+3q-33 = 0
=> 3p+q = 11
The values of p,q satisfying equation will be (1,8), (2,5), (3,2)
Hence, the possible equations will be 
1. $8x^2+x-24=0$  Discriminant D= 1+4*24*8 = 769
2. $5x^2+2x-24=0$ Discriminant D= 2*2+5*24*4 = 484
3. $2x^2+3x-24=0$ Discriminant D= 3*3+4*2*24 = 201
For integral roots, the discriminant should be perfect square, a condition which is satisfied by equation 2.
Hence, p=2 and q=5  => p+2q = 2+2*5 = 12
